What do we have for Ghorman?''"
[Bon grunts]|quoteend=0|Niki and Bon|audio=Niki-Bon-IHFE.flac|}} '''Bon''' was an [[Bon's species|alien]] who, along with the [[human]] [[Niki]], was proprietor of the [[Niki-Bon Travel Agency]] on the [[planet]] [[Coruscant]]. In [[3 BBY]], the pair were in the agency's back room when [[Cassian Jeron Andor|Cassian Andor]] of the [[Axis network]] arrived at the building. Niki emerged first to speak with Andor but called for Bon after he asked to travel to the planet [[Ghorman]] and used the phrase "I have friends everywhere." Andor later left and traveled to Ghorman. ==Biography== {{Quote|[Niki laughs]
[Andor knocks on the window]
''«Stop! Someone here!»''|quotestart=0|quoteend=0|italics=0|Niki whispers to Bon|audio=Niki-Stop-IHFE.flac|}} [[File:Bon-Niki-FriendsEverywhere.png|thumb|right|300px|alt=Bon, a large alien with gray skin, emerges from a beaded curtain behind Niki in the Niki-Bon Travel Agency.|Bon and Niki were co-proprietors of the Niki-Bon Travel Agency.]] Bon was the [[Bon's species|alien]] proprietor of the eponymous [[Niki-Bon Travel Agency]] on an upper level of{{Databank|niki-bon-travel-agency|Niki-Bon travel agency}} the [[planet]]''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia: The Comprehensive Guide to the Star Wars Galaxy]]'' [[Coruscant]] during the [[Imperial Era|reign]] of the [[Galactic Empire]]. He resided with [[Niki]], his [[human]] co-proprietor, in a room in the back of the office of the agency where in [[3 BBY]],{{AndorDate|205}} the pair were laughing together when the rebel [[Axis network]] member [[Cassian Jeron Andor|Cassian Andor]] arrived at the building and knocked on the [[Viewport|window]]. Hearing Andor, Niki told Bon to stop what he was doing and then left the back room to let Andor in. Bon remained in the back room while she spoke with Andor, but after the rebel asked about transport to the [[Colonies]][[Star Wars Galaxy Map (poster)|''Star Wars'' Galaxy Map poster]] planet''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' [[Ghorman]] and used the phrase "I have friends everywhere"—which was used by members of the network to identify allies{{Andor|What a Festive Evening}}—Niki called to Bon and asked what they had for Ghorman. Bon then emerged shirtless from the back room and grunted while looking at Andor. The rebel later left the travel agency with a new piece of luggage and traveled to Ghorman via the [[Coruscant Eastern Spaceport]]. ==Personality and traits== For the right price, Niki and Bon were willing to help a potential customer at any [[Standard hour|hour]]. He had white [[hair]], gray skin, pale [[eye]]s with no eyebrows, and was giant in terms of height. ==Skills and abilities== Bon understood [[Galactic Basic Standard]], but while they were in the back room together Niki used another [[language]] while speaking to him. ==Equipment== When Andor visited the travel agency, Bon wore black [[Clothing|pants]] and an open brown jacket with red and gray stripes but no shirt. ==Behind the scenes== [[File:BonCostume.jpg|thumb|200px|Michael Wilkinson putting together Bon's costume]] Bon was portrayed by [[Elliott Rennie]] in "[[I Have Friends Everywhere]]," the fifth episode of the [[Andor Season 2|second season]] of the [[Disney+]] live-action series [[Star Wars: Andor|''Andor'']], which aired on [[April 29]], [[2025]].{{SW|url=news/andor-season-2-teaser-trailer-key-art-reveal|text=First ''Andor A Star Wars Story'' Teaser Trailer and Poster Revealed}} Character designner [[Tom Blake]] created concept art of Bon, with one piece focus on the character's hair and another showing the character shirtless with blond hair across his chest and stomach.{{WebCite|url=https://www.tomblakedesign.com/design/andor2|text=STAR WARS ANDOR SEASON 2|author=[[Tom Blake]]|work=[https://www.tomblakedesign.com Tom Blake Design]|archivedate=20250623003358}} Costume designer [[Michael Wilkinson]] worked on Bon's costume.{{Instagram|username=michaelwilkinson|url=p/DK0BmDNh3I8|name=[[Michael Wilkinson]]|date=2025-06-12|quote=I've got to give the hugest shout-out to my magifient crew for #Andor - the most talented bunch of people I've ever had the pleasure of working with. Headed up by Costume Supervisor Kate O'Farrell and ACDs Richard Davies & Paula Fajardo. We were endlessly supported by our core team of 92 fulltime costumers, plus dozens of additonal day-players for big shooting days. Thank you from the bottom of my heart - without you there would be no Andor costumes. #costumes #costumedesign #starwars #thegreatest|archiveurl=https://archive.is/0sqwU|archivefile=File:MichaelWilkinson-BonCostume-Instagram.png}} {{Gallery |source=''[[Star Wars: Andor]]'' |storyboards= |concept= File:BonConcept1-TomBlake.jpg|Concept design by Tom Blake File:BonConcept2-TomBlake.jpg|Concept design by Tom Blake |digital= |in-progress= }} ==Appearances== {{Indexpage}} {{Mediacat|imagecat=Images of Bon}} *{{Andor|I Have Friends Everywhere}} {{1st}} ==Sources== *{{SW|url=news/andor-trivia-guide-week-2|text=Secrets from the Set of ''Andor'' Season 2: Week 2 Trivia}} {{C|In [[Niki-Bon Travel Agency]]'s name}} *{{Databank|niki-bon-travel-agency|Niki-Bon travel agency}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |ka=ბონი }} [[Category:Individuals of unidentified species]] [[Category:Individuals of unspecified gender]] [[Category:Individuals with he/him pronouns]]
